replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I'm gonna be really honest here.

That triangle shape looks really awesome.
While I do have to agree with kycrafft, I think just adding more variation in the "floor" of the main islands and adding structures/deformations in the terrain (or even breaking it up into void islands) will make it more interesting. I prefer generally flat maps, and this looks pretty awesome!
My only concern is that first chest in the imgur album, it looks awfully overpowered...

Overall +1 from me c:
